defects.note: SELECT with a comment after the keyword, a CASE expression in the select list, and 'FROM DUAL' only inside a comment and a string; the real source is a table
SELECT INTO after a sibling block with its own NO_DATA_FOUND handler, inside a loop; the only enclosing handler is ZERO_DIVIDE
SELECT INTO inside a local function with no handler anywhere
aggregate-only select list BUT with GROUP BY, so not exempt
SELECT INTO in the ELSE branch of an $IF/$ELSE conditional-compilation directive, no handler

negatives.note: SELECT INTO in the innermost of three labelled nested blocks; the outermost block handles TOO_MANY_ROWS
aggregate-only list with comments between items, and FROM DUAL split across two lines
SELECT ... INTO only in a q-quoted string and a comment; real statements are BULK COLLECT INTO and INSERT INTO ... SELECT (no SELECT INTO)
handler lists ZERO_DIVIDE OR TOO_MANY_ROWS over two lines in the enclosing block; SELECT sits after a nested procedure
SELECT INTO inside a CASE branch inside a loop; the enclosing block has WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE (OTHERS counts as handling for this rule)
